mapper.insert: insert ignore into payment_flow( flow_no, order_id, user_id, pay_channel, channel_trade_no, pay_amount, pay_status, pay_time, raw_message, create_time, update_time ) values( #{flowNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{payChannel}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{payTime}, #{rawMessage}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select count(1) from payment_flow pf left join third_party_bill tb on tb.order_id = pf.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'PAY' where pf.pay_status = 'SUCCESS' and tb.id is null

select pf.id, pf.flow_no, pf.order_id, pf.user_id, pf.pay_channel, pf.channel_trade_no, pf.pay_amount, pf.pay_status, pf.pay_time, pf.raw_message, pf.create_time, pf.update_time from payment_flow pf left join third_party_bill tb on tb.order_id = pf.order_id and tb.bill_type = 'PAY' where pf.pay_status = 'SUCCESS' and tb.id is null order by pf.pay_time asc limit #{limit}
